name: Student in Colombo
description: Budget template for a university student living alone in Colombo, typically in a boarding house or shared apartment near campus. Covers basic needs on a tight budget.
tips: Cook at home to save on food costs
Use public buses instead of tuk-tuks for daily commute
Buy second-hand textbooks or share with classmates
Open a savings account and automate LKR 5,000 transfer on payday

name: Family in Kandy
description: Budget template for a family of four (2 adults, 2 school-age children) in Kandy. One primary earner with a government or private sector job, spouse may do part-time work.
tips: Buy groceries in bulk from Kandy market to save 15-20%
Consider a CTB monthly bus pass for school children
Set aside LKR 3,000/month for medical emergencies
Enroll children in public school to reduce education costs

name: Young Professional in Galle
description: Budget template for a single working professional in their late 20s to mid-30s in Galle, likely in tourism, finance, or IT sector. Moderate lifestyle with some savings goals.
tips: Invest LKR 10,000/month in a fixed deposit for 6-12 months
Use a motorbike for commuting to save on transport
Take advantage of Galle Fort area weekend markets for fresh produce
Consider term life insurance now while premiums are lower

name: Retired Couple in Matara
description: Budget template for a retired couple in Matara living on pension income. Children are grown and independent. Focus on healthcare, comfortable living, and maintaining savings.
tips: Register at the nearest Sevana clinic for subsidized medication
Keep LKR 100,000 in a liquid savings account for medical emergencies
Consider a senior citizen fixed deposit - banks offer higher rates
Review insurance policy annually to ensure adequate health coverage

name: Family in Jaffna
description: Budget template for a family of five in Jaffna (2 adults, 3 children including one in Advanced Level). Typical middle-income family with own home, focused on children's education.
tips: A/L tuition classes can be expensive - compare prices carefully
Jaffna market has excellent fresh vegetables - buy weekly
Consider a Sampath or NSB savings account for children's education fund
Apply for Mahapola or Bursary scholarships for university-bound children

name: Factory Worker Family in Gampaha
description: Budget template for a working-class family of four in Gampaha where both adults work in the free trade zone or local factories. Tight budget with focus on essentials and loan repayments.
tips: Check if your factory has a cooperative society for low-interest loans
Keep a physical expense notebook to track daily cash spending
Enroll in the Employees' Trust Fund (ETF) - your employer must contribute
Avoid microfinance loans with very high interest rates
